key_highlights: Aussie shares drop ahead of critical RBA interest rate decision amid persistent inflation and fiscal pressures.
Westpac posts $6.8B profit but models an 11% property price fall as housing downturn accelerates across major capitals.
Australian housing market faces worst auction conditions since 2020, marking seven straight months of value declines.
Global risk aversion intensifies following a $1.4T Wall Street wipeout and precious metals capitulation.

sectors.trend: Westpac reports $6.8B profit while warning of an 11% house price contraction and rising debt funding costs.
sectors.implications: Credit growth deceleration and asset quality risks pose headwind for major lenders (WBC.AX, CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX).

sectors.trend: Gold capitulation dampens bullion sentiment, but junior exploration across WA targets gold and critical manganese.
sectors.implications: Short-term margin headwinds for gold producers (NST.AX, EVN.AX), while long-term strategic focus remains on battery metals (AX8.AX, BHP.AX).

sectors.trend: Seven consecutive months of home price drops, weak auction clearance, and valuation downgrades compress real estate demand.
sectors.implications: A-REITs face further asset write-downs and higher debt refinancing burdens, weighing on distributions (GMG.AX, MGR.AX, SCG.AX).

sectors.trend: Rising cost-of-living and debt burdens dent retail demand, accelerating M&A consolidation talks.
sectors.implications: Selective takeover support emerges for beaten-down retailers (KMD.AX), though broader discretionary retail faces margin compression.

sectors.trend: Coal plant retirements in Victoria threaten significant upward pressure on wholesale and retail electricity tariffs.
sectors.implications: Supports earnings for integrated utilities and renewable generators (AGL.AX, ORG.AX), despite regulatory cost-of-living intervention risk.

key_themes: RBA Rate Tightening and Fiscal Inflation Conflict
Persistent Property Market and Auction Downturn
Global Equity Volatility and Capital Outflows
Corporate Balance Sheet Pressures and Cost-Cutting

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight rate-sensitive equities; tilt toward defensive cash generators and high-yield short-duration instruments.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Deepening Housing Slump and Mortgage Impairments
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge exposure to retail banking and domestic residential property trusts; monitor non-performing loan ratios.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global Contagion from Wall Street Sell-off
risk_assessment.mitigation: Utilize protective index put options on ^AXJO and retain USD cash buffers against equity drawdowns.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Surging Corporate and Sovereign Borrowing Costs
risk_assessment.mitigation: Prioritize investment-grade balance sheets with low leverage ratios and unencumbered free cash flow.

opportunities.recommendation: Allocate to Defensive Energy and Utilities Providers
opportunities.rationale: Structural electricity supply constraints and rising power tariffs bolster regulated revenue streams.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on Retail Consolidation M&A Catalysts
opportunities.rationale: Takeover interest from offshore private equity and retail conglomerates creates near-term arbitrage and upside.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Exposure to Major Domestic Lenders and REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Westpac's 11% property decline forecast and multi-year low auction clearances signal worsening credit headwinds.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge Broad Market Downside via Index Options
defensive_moves.rationale: Pre-RBA risk aversion coupled with US equity contagion poses substantial asymmetric downside risk for Australian equities.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish bias through Q4 2026 as the ASX absorbs RBA rate hikes, housing contraction, and Wall Street volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautious recovery over 6–12 months predicated on terminal cash rate visibility and stable resource demand from North Asia.
key_catalysts: RBA Board cash rate decision and monetary policy commentary
Australian quarterly CPI and real wage growth prints
US midterm election results and Federal Reserve rate trajectory
Major Australian banking earnings and loan loss provision figures
watch_list: CoreLogic capital city home value indices and weekend auction clearance rates
AUD/USD cross-currency movements against RBA rate expectations
Iron ore (62% Fe CFR) and thermal coal export prices
